heading: Relative-offset coordinates
text:
### Relative-offset coordinates [LTSL.3.1]

Timeline coordinates are duration-literal offsets from the test's start (`0_s`,
`5_min`, `100_ms`), grouped in `at <dur>:` blocks. Relative offsets drive the
**monotonic** engine clock that `ttl`, `cooldown`, and `then within` read. The
test runner must set the wall clock ([LTIM.2.8.3]) to the coordinate's offset from
the Unix epoch, so `at 5_s` is 1970-01-01T00:00:05Z, and it is the epoch itself at
the test's start. `now()` and an engine-filled `ts` ([LFAC.9.2]) read it.
